title: Divide Array Into Equal Pairs
statement: Return true if the array can be partitioned into pairs of equal values.
explanation: Every value must occur an even number of times.

title: Count Hills and Valleys in an Array
statement: Count interior positions that are hills or valleys after consecutive equal values are treated as one run.
explanation: Compress adjacent duplicates, then count strict local maxima and minima in the compressed array.

title: Find the Difference of Two Arrays
statement: Return the distinct values present only in nums1 and only in nums2.
explanation: Convert both arrays to sets and compute the two directional set differences.

title: Minimum Bit Flips to Convert Number
statement: Return the number of bit positions where start and goal differ.
explanation: XOR identifies differing bit positions; count its set bits.

title: Minimum Number of Operations to Convert Time
statement: Convert current time to correct time using increments of 60, 15, 5, and 1 minute; return the minimum operation count.
explanation: Convert both times to minutes and greedily consume each increment from largest to smallest.

title: Add Two Integers
statement: Return the sum of num1 and num2.
explanation: Integer addition directly computes the required result.

title: Root Equals Sum of Children
statement: Return true if the root value equals the sum of its two children.
explanation: Add the left and right child values and compare with the root value.

title: Find Closest Number to Zero
approach: Minimize absolute value and prefer positive ties
statement: Return the array value closest to zero; if tied, return the larger value.
explanation: Compare absolute values, choosing the larger number when distances tie.

title: Calculate Digit Sum of a String
statement: Partition the digit string into groups of k, replace each group with its digit sum, and repeat until length is at most k.
explanation: Build each round from consecutive chunks of length k and preserve each chunk sum as decimal text.

title: Count Prefixes of a Given String
statement: Count words that are prefixes of s.
explanation: A word qualifies exactly when s starts with that word.
